# Ex 23 · Strings, Bytes and Character Encodings

`str` 是文字，`bytes` 是原始字节。编解码用 UTF-8 最常见。

## 目标
- 用 `.encode("utf-8")` / `.decode("utf-8")`
- 看懂中文等多字节字符

## 自检
- [ ] 编码后看到 `b'...'`
- [ ] 解码后文字恢复

starterFiles.ex23.py:
text = "你好, LPTHW! café ☕"
print("original:", text)
print("type:", type(text))

raw = text.encode("utf-8")
print("encoded bytes:", raw)
print("byte length:", len(raw), "| char length:", len(text))

back = raw.decode("utf-8")
print("decoded:", back)
print("round-trip ok?", back == text)

print("\nHex view:", raw.hex(" "))
